title: Court lets New Hampshire homeowners pursue group trespass claim over chemical water pollution
summary_full: A federal appeals court has permitted New Hampshire homeowners to advance a class-action trespass claim against Saint-Gobain. However, the court denied group treatment for negligence and failure-to-warn claims due to individual property assessments. Contamination of drinking water due to PFOA emissions from a manufacturing plant has been identified. The ruling acknowledged the homeowners' right to seek compensation while leaving individual claims to be determined later.
